description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the BLEU score and the length of the gold prefix for two experimental conditions: “Consistency: wait-1” and “Inconsistency: wait-9,” as evaluated in the context of simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled “the length of gold prefix,” spans from 0 to 20 with integer tick marks at every 5 units, indicating discrete prefix lengths. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 23 to 29, with major gridlines and tick labels at every 1 BLEU point. The “Consistency: wait-1” condition is represented by a blue dashed line with open circle markers; it begins at approximately BLEU 24.7 at prefix length 0, dips to 23.8 at length 1, then generally increases with fluctuations, reaching 28.1 at length 20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” condition is shown as a red dashed line with square markers; it starts at BLEU 25.1 at length 0, rises to a peak of about 25.9 at length 6, then declines and stabilizes around 25.2–25.5 from length 14 to 19, before rising slightly to 25.7 at length 20. A gray rectangular patch is visible near the y-axis between BLEU 25 and 26, though its purpose is not labeled. The plot suggests that BLEU scores improve with longer gold prefixes under the consistent condition, while the inconsistent condition shows more volatility and lower overall performance.
